capabilities: Draw symbols on a canvas with font-line guides
Save each symbol as a plain PNG file
Insert symbols inline as image embeds
Insert a symbol by typing a trigger and part of its name
Trace a pasted picture into ink strokes
disambiguation: Not a general drawing or handwriting canvas; it makes single symbols saved as PNG images for inline use in text.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. Symbols are ordinary PNG files embedded with normal image links, so notes still show them if the plugin is disabled or uninstalled. The file format is frozen as of 1.0.0; symbols saved before 0.9.2 open only as a picture to draw over. Detailed usage, limits and troubleshooting live in an external user guide.
problem: Scripts and personal symbols that no font contains cannot be typed into a note, so there is no easy way to write with them.
summary: Draws custom symbols on a canvas, saves each as a PNG in the vault, and inserts them inline in notes like characters.
